product_one_liner.value: Octopus Deploy automates software deployments, release orchestration, and operational runbooks for software development, DevOps, and platform engineering teams.

hq_location.notes: Headquarters is in South Brisbane, Queensland.

eng_blog.notes: Andrew Best describes the architecture for developing deployment steps; Rob Pearson explains the Calamari and Sashimi modularization of Octopus.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current board lists two Revenue Systems Specialist vacancies and three generic expressions-of-interest listings; none has a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: The Assistant uses Azure OpenAI; the Claude Agent Step requires the customer’s own Anthropic API key.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center claims SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001:2022, plus GDPR compliance; GDPR is a regulatory compliance claim, not a certification.

last_funding.notes: CB Insights records January 1, 2024; the month is database-reported, not independently confirmed by a company announcement. Dated October 2025 reporting explicitly says the financing was secured in 2024, rather than in October 2025.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified US$30 million investment was secured in 2024, outside May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026; October 2025 is the reporting date.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The complete current board contains revenue-systems roles and generic expressions of interest, with no SDR, BDR, or Account Executive title.

launched_6mo.notes: Feature Flags entered public preview July 13, 2026; Remote MCP was announced October 13, 2026, both within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Josh VanGeest’s profile lists VP Revenue Operations at Octopus Deploy from March through July 2026, establishing both a join and a departure within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The posting says Octopus is migrating from Salesforce to HubSpot and maintains HubSpot–Zuora integrations; Zuora is a connected billing/revenue system.
